about.title: About us
about.story: Hulun Trade was established in 2015 in Yiwu, Zhejiang, China. We are an industrial and trading enterprise specializing in the production and export of high-quality candies, including marshmallows, gummies, and handmade hard candies. Our products are exported to Russia, the Middle East, South America, Southeast Asia, and Africa. We also support comprehensive OEM services to manufacture customized sweets for brands worldwide.
about.closing: We are proud of our professional team and our commitment to delivering safe, delicious, and joyful sweet treats to families and partners across the globe!
